faq.title: What every store owner asks before trying it
faq.subtitle: If your question is not here, support answers on chat during business hours — before you sign up for anything.

migration.question: Will I have to register my products one by one?
migration.answer: No. You send us your product spreadsheet (or the export from your current system) and our team runs the import with you, including stock balances, cost prices and sale prices. Migration is included in every plan at no extra cost.

trial.question: How does the 14-day trial work?
trial.answer: You create an account without entering a card and use the whole platform — register, stock, finance and invoicing. Nothing is locked during the trial. We remind you on the last day, and everything you set up stays there if you decide to subscribe.

cancel.question: If I cancel, do I lose my data?
cancel.answer: No. You cancel from the dashboard itself, with no penalty and no phone call. Before closing the account you export products, customers and sales as CSV. We keep your data available for 30 days after cancellation in case you change your mind.

support.question: What kind of support do I get?
support.answer: On Essential, email support answered within 1 business day. On Professional, chat during business hours with people who understand store operations. On Enterprise, an account manager and a contracted SLA. On every plan, initial setup is done with you.

hardware.question: Do I need to buy new equipment?
hardware.answer: In most cases, no. Axius Store runs in the browser on any computer and works with the most common barcode scanners and thermal printers on the market. If you are unsure about your hardware, send us the model and we will confirm before you subscribe.

offline.question: What if the internet drops mid-rush?
offline.answer: The register tells you the moment the connection drops and shows the status of the sale in progress, so you never charge twice or lose the record. When the connection returns, syncing runs automatically and you can review what was sent.

invoice.question: Is tax invoicing included?
invoice.answer: Yes, on the Professional and Enterprise plans, issued straight from the register. You configure the tax profile per product type once and the system applies the right tax codes to every sale. The digital certificate stays on your side.
